reviews.review_description: Issues with brands installed.

I have no issues with the installation in 2018. However I have an issue with the SolarEdge inverter and CSA services is not contactable.The web site domain name registration has lapsed. I don't think the business is operating any more.The image is the error code the inverter shows, and is not currently working. I have contacted another solar company to replace the broken Inverter via warranty.

This was the second system I had installed by Paul at CSA. Paul knows his stuff and does a fantastic Job both speccing and installing. If anything goes wrong Paul always answers the phone and answers questions and helps getting things resolved. Premium gear,Premium installation and premium service. Have recommend to friends and family and have had the same feedback. Definitely would recommend.
Only company that sent out an advisor who spent an hour up on the roof, measuring and checking out best positioning. Excellent after sales. Qkr! Company so why look elsewhere?

The quoting process was made extremely easy and transparent with honesty provided by the salesman throughout.Installation went off without a hitch and so far the ongoing customer service has been great!

The quoting process was easy, I managed to get a top quality system at a great price. The installation was effortless, they arrived on time and everything went according to plan. They were very organised, polite and tidy. I would highly recommend CSA Services, they even helped to organise the grid connection after the installation. Thanks Solar Quotes and CSA Services.
We were impressed with all companies you recommended and the information received. CSA were professional right from the first on site meeting and knew their product really well.

I am still awaiting an updated Schematic Circuit Diagram to go in the Operators manual, supplied.  The diagram to reflect actual changes made to the proposed installation.  An e-mail reminder for this diagram update request, was only issued yesterday, 19Mar 2019.

The whole process was so easy and the installaion was done quickly and professionally. The team was very friendly and answered all our questions.Thanks Paul and Catherine for the great service, will definately refer my friends to your wonderful business.
All went very smoothly - Every thing was well organised and completed on the day. Replacement of switchboard was required and included in original quote
Great company to deal with even though the installation was a bit trickier than quoted for.  Highly recommended.

Unfortunately we weren't aware that our supplier would drag out our meter reconfiguration (new house new meter which electricians say is OK for solar power) for as long as possible, delaying us  getting credit for surplus power generated. We are still waiting for the supplier to get off their butt. We have reported their tardiness to the ombudsman.
The last two are average because on the installation day they hit us for an extra $500 (7.54%) to upgrade our power board, which supposedly has asbestos in it.

Thanks to you Finn for making the opportunity available where I could get a good cross section of quotes from different Operators.  In the end I chose the system I felt best suited my family and was a good quality system.  Of course I have to take the word of the sales person however with all companies who quoted, all sales persons were from a technical background and not just trying to sell their product.  I chose Solar Edge from CSA Services because it was from my perspective the best of the systems offered and not necessarily the cheapest.  I rated all questions 4 star.  I never give anyone a Fantastic rating.  At the end of the day, the proof is in the eating of the pudding.  Once I have had my system working for a while then I can make an informed decision on my system.CheersHarry

Was really happy with the original quote, with no hard sell unlike some of the other companies. Roy was very happy to work with me to design exactly what I wanted, within my budget. Installation guys were friendly and after sales service has been prompt.
A bit slow to get the quote out!
Installer guys were really nice and kept me Informed especially as there were some issues with the roof trusses.

CSA quoted for and delivered the system I wanted. No hard selling or upsell. Good value products and service. It took 2 days for the decommission and install in 39 degree heat but hey did a great job.

Overall very good experience with CSA. Great sales experience (Very experienced ex-installer as sales guy - Roy), Very good product offering (Solar Edge Inverter), best price, some confusion during the install lead time (but not a big deal), fantastic install team (Very professional guys - Wayne, install date was in-line with original estimates). No issues since install (now 2 weeks). Would definitely recommend CSA.
Itâ€™s really worth shopping around and really doing your homework on each system - solarquotes really help with this background work too!
Only one missing bit of information- Origin takes 30 days to connect system to the grid, and instal new meter, and until then the system is off. Not happy!!

Installation went fine, but aftersales service is disappointing.We went through SolarQuotes for 3 quotes, 2 installers replied, one couldn't be bothered to get back to me. The 2 quotes we got were for very similar price, used the same racking system (Radiant), same inverter (Fronius), just different solar panels. In the end we opted for a bigger system (10.8kW) installed by CSA Services, for the budgeted price. From initial consultation to final sign off we are very pleased we chose CSA. The initial consultation was conducted by an electrician, not a salesman like the others. He was informed, polite and not pushy. We had a lot of questions, some on the day, and many after, which were answered promptly and to our satisfaction. We had to wait a while for the inverter to be supplied, but the installation was professional, neat and tidy, and exactly as we had requested. The weather unfortunately didn't cooperate, requiring the completion of installation to the next day. There was a 3 week delay until the electricity meter was replaced, while I was itching to turn the system on. That happened yesterday, and today the system is running. Quite addictive (and informative) to be able to monitor how much power is being consumed, and how much is being generated with the App from Fronius.We are were very pleased with CSA Services, until I noted a fault in the data from the Fronius smart meter. The system apparently never exported any electricity back into the grid, despite producing in excess of 7kW, with no power consumption apart from the fridge and pool pump. I called and informed them of the problem, and was told they will get back to me as soon as someone has looked at the data. A week went by with no reply. I called again, and again the same promise of getting back to me was never fulfilled for week. I called again, a little annoyed at this stage, and was met with a rude reply that they will get back to me. It took 4 weeks for them to get back to me and send someone out to have a look.The initial consultation and installation went smoothly, and the system works, but the aftersales service leaves much to the imagination.

Sales process was very informative and thorough.  The system was installed with no issues at all and everything was very well done, with great attention to detail.  very happy with our new solar system producing plenty of energy!
Not good customer contact after contract signed.  Would have made a different decision had I known that it would take so long to get installed.
Great company to deal with from the initial quote to the installation.

CSA Services were less than great with communications. I had to remind them that I had accepted their quote. A query I made went unanswered for 3+weeks despite 2 follow-up requests. When the query was finally answered by phone I was promised an email confirmation which has not arrived.  Information provided by me in an email was not passed on to the installation crew with the result that they had to return another day to complete the job.  Everything worked out in the end and I'm pleased with the system I got.
Everything was smooth, and it was so easy working people from CSA.

The salesman was great. The installation was a comedy of errors!  The subcontracted panel man did not install as per the agreed layout,  he did his own arrangement. The outside meterbox was underwhelming with its off kilter plywood repair of the wall.  The inside switchboard could not be configured with what box they had and they fixed it in a way that it could not open! The inverter was not switched on so initially was it not producing power (for the first week) and the paperwork was all done up in the name of a technician that did not even install the system.THEN they asked me to pay for all that! I declined to pay.I had tried to contact the salesman but he went off line ( in fact he was on leave but this was not communicated to me). After a few days the salesman Roy called me at night, when he finally got to hear of my complaints. I sent him photos. He also seemed surprised it had all gone so wrong. He apologised and organised for everything to be fixed. On 28/3/19 it all got sorted. And now its making lots of power! Alinta is due to swap the meter on 2/5/19.I think the problem was a lack of supervision  for the installation.

The up sell, with respect to batteries, from SAE Group completely turned me off their company. As an electrical engineer, I was really annoyed with the salesperson. I'm not an idiot! CSA are awesome, and they listen to their customer, i.e. the people who pay their wage...  I am concerned that so many customers must get exactly what the solar company wants them to have - and these are the supposedly legit companies...
Very satisfied
We were very happy with CSA from every perspective.
Excellent from quote to installation and great after care service as well. Kept us informed via email with updates and was able to answer any questions we had. Very happy with CSA.

The service from all contacts in this company was great. The time for permission for our oversized system from Energex was explained and as soon as we had permission, we were able to go ahead with our installation. The installation went smoothly and there was no clean up for us after the tradesmen had left. The system is working beautifully and for the first time, we are waiting for our next electricity bill.

From start to finish both Solar Quotes and CSA Services made it a very easy process. We have now had the system in for 4 months and our quarterly bill for November, December and January has gone from around $850 to $290, living in QLD the a/c has been cranking over this time with 5 people living in the house. The app that comes with the system for your phone gives great real time information on the system as a whole or individual panels. Very happy.

Great all round experience.  The rep who came round seemed genuinely interested in getting the best system for our needs rather than their standard system or the most expensive one. Fitting was a very easy process and after care has been spot on. Our system will have paid for itself in just over 2 years at the rate it us going and our first full solar quarter has turned a substantial bill into a good sized refund. Many thanks.

These people were all very professional - from the sales team and installers to the office folks. Bigger companies could learn from them about customer service. As the project progressed we were kept in the loop with info sheets, calls and email.  We were kept informed on what was happening and when. Unusual these days unfortunately.The install went smoothly with meter connection and supplier info all handled by them.Very highly recomended.

Time it takes to get a smart meter is a bit ordinary.Price difference for comparative systems.Really need to do your research and be comfortable .. I was really close to getting a solaredge inverter but some online comments gave me concerns re longevity.Your site was really helpful. Thanks.
Using Solarquotes gave us plenty of very helpful information about choosing the right product and supplier for our solar installation.
Very happy with this company. Installed and up and running on the same day. Good quality products.

We've had our 13kW SolarEdge system installed for 12 months now.  We've not had any issues and are very happy.  I'd happily recommend CSA to anyone - good experience with the sales, install and post install support.

Even though I went for a 6.5kwW system I still only get max 4.5kW at the peak, I'm guessing due the orientation.The retail provider is taking over a month to come out and put the smart meter in.Meter box price was too low in quote so gave me a bit of a shock.There was alot of work in the installation, so the cost made a bit more sense when it happened.The hot water was put on a day timer, but since we had a small system, I had to put it back to cover night and morning showers.

CSA has been so easy to work with. Personable and efficient. The salesperson was so helpful in walking us thorugh what is/was required. The installation team are efficient and competent. Overall its been a positive experience. Now we wait for the good results.

We installed a 6.5kW system with a 5kW SolarEdge inverter.  The inverter failed after 48 hours.   Due to Melbourne Cup Day, it was 5 days before it was replaced.   We could not fault the salesman or the installers, they were all very helpful and professional.

Good to deal with an engineer in configuring and finalising design of the system, particulary with use of optimisers to minimise impact of shade on the roof. With several other companies I felt the sales person was following a fixed recipe and didn't technically understand how to address the roof shade issue.I now await completion of the grid connection work by Origin Energy and monitoring the output from the system.

Once it is installed you are on your own. We are still not connected to the grid and Origin are completely hopeless at providing any information about a switch over date. Spent one hour 20 minutes on the phone trying to speak to them and still did not get through. When I called their sales line all they could say was that "new connections are always very busy." CSA could I believe be more pro-active since they have the option as a contractor to join the Origin on-line connections system. I gather all suppliers are the same but it still leaves a very bad taste on the industry as a whole.
We found CSA very knowledgeable and efficient.
good clean and prompt install with no hassles.
yes the other 2 suppliers were just a waste of time
Great company, honest and reliable.
Installers were polite and explained how to use the system to our greatest advantage. Our sales rep, Antony was also very polite and even after sales offer to answer any questions if we needed.
I also like the fact that CSA offer annual maintenance service which involves cleaning the panels and checking the system is functioning at its optimum.

The installers were worth their weight in gold. There was a problem with the roof plan and the CSA installers sorted it out with out hesitation and were great about explaining everything along the way. Wonderful.

Hello Finn,Thank you for the information we received by email from you.  It allowed us to choose the type of system we required for the trees surrounding our house.  Our house is set up for three phase and for some unknown reason our energy retailer  said this could be a problem.  I don't know why when we have dealt with them for the past 25 years.  When the day came to connect to the grid, there was no problem.  The solar panels  with optimisers and the inverter were installed a fortnight after the contract was signed and   the deposit was paid.  The final payment was paid on completion of the installation.  The only hiccough was waiting 5 weeks to be connected to the grid by our retailer.Thank you for all your help.Fred Harvie

After several quotes and hours of internet search, I have made an excellent decision to go with CSA Services. Process was quick from start to finish and team are extremely professional. Highly recommended

It was a pleasure to buy the Solar System from CSA. The Salesman, Antony, was extremely knowledgeable, and very helpful throughout the negotiations.Not the cheapest quote we received, but, I believe the best value for the quality of equipment supplied.The installation was completed in a day, within 2 weeks of our decision to order. ( they have their own crew, not subcontractors)Office Staff were also very cordial, and helpful.As we live in S E Queensland, we were always going to choose a company from this area, for the benefit of service, or additions, if required at a later date.We would highly recommend this company.
Great service from start to finish with an amazing system.

CSA was a very professional company and kept us informed of progress and next steps throughout the process.  The installers arrived on time and completed the job within the timeframe given and to a high standard.  Information provided about the system was very comprehensive and useful.  Would certainly recommend them to others looking for a quality solar system
System has been installed but still waiting on electricity supplier to change over to the grid. So still in progress
Very quick, very professional, absolutely no fuss in and out - BRILLIANT :)
Such an easy process with CSA, we were kept in constant contact and the day of install the guys & lady were fantastic! Very professional & tidy.

Initially, the team were very accommodating to install in a short timeframe. The team arrived and departed 10 mins later saying that my roof was dangerous and they would not install the panels. I had to call and call to get any answers, and it was only after getting hold of the owner that anything happened. He was very good, and personally sorted out the issues (there was nothing wrong with my roof....). The install finally happened and was satisfactory. Their issue resolution process was pretty average, but got there in the end.
Great company to deal with, came back to me promptly any time I had a question.
Taking time to switch on due to switching electrical supply but the system is great with a good app so I can see each individual panel and what it is producing

Great product. Very informative sales person. Office staff were not that good, took deposit twice and then called to say I hadn't paid my final account when I had. They then had made a mistake with the final invoice.
very happy
Very good customer service. Extremely professional in the design and execution of the solar. Highly recommend.

I like the way that CSA provides a quote and that is it. No haggles, no steak knives, that is it. Other suppliers tried to up sell, down sell and so forth. Don't have time for all that. If the quote is good, grab it.

Very satisfied and would happily recommend CSA. Great and once they quoted they left it to us to decide. Other companies very pushing with calls for the sale. we got a quality product and are very happy we chose to install with them.Prompt after sales service to assess a very minor fault which they picked up on.

Paul and Cath were extremly professional and reliable throughout the entire process, from quote right through to installation. They have provided ongoing support for any questions we had about our system after installation. I would highly recommend their services.

Excellent from start to finish, and fantastic follow-up information and service. No hard selling, Roy just let his price and quality speak for themselves. Excellent system and quality installation. Will happily recommend CSA Services to anyone who asks.

Sales rep was very informative and professional.  Once we had decided who we were going with the installation was booked within the same week.  Installers were very prompt, professional and considerate.  We are now waiting on our electricity supplier to install the digital meter.

From the time I requested quotes through SolarQuotes to the time of installation was less than 2 weeks. Very happy with the whole process and the installation from CSA Services was fast and had no issues at all. Everything was explained and customer service was great.
A very smooth and professional experience.

6kW SolarEdge HD Wave inverter with 8kW of Canadian Solar panels. Pool pump connected to inverter via wireless switch so that it only operates when there is sufficient excess solar power available. Went with CSA Services as they were the most willing to design a system which met my requirements (which included the ability to switch appliances on/off based on available solar power thereby enabling me to maximise self-consumption). Very happy with system and install. It has been operating for almost 4 weeks now without any issues.

Not the best Price, but the very best Overall Service.Roy Baker from CSA Services Quoted, and was willing to come back a second time to explain the System.Courteney & Karen of CSA Services, in Admin. Most Helpful.Installation Crew of 5, the Best. Kept us up to date while working.Adrian Kay : InstallerJayden : Fitting the Fronius Primo 5.0 InverterAdrian, Dean, Brady, Lana, fitting our Brand New Canadian 300w Solar Panels on our Terracotta Tiled Roof.We would recommend CSA Services.Regards, Dewsberry
CSA Services were very good to deal with including following through after installation to ensure Origin and Energex did their part.

We already had a quote from a door to door salesperson from another company.Other Solar Quotes referral never contacted us to arrange quote (apart from initial email saying they would be in contact within 3 days!!)CSA Representative was extremely professional and helpful, did a thorough inspection and talked us through the options. He provided us with a quote within 2 days and we accepted. the installation team were very friendly and professional and did a great job.Overall would thoroughly recommend them.
20*275W Canadian Solar panels (Made in China!!!) and Fronius Primo 5.0 inverter
It would be helpful to have a more detailed user guide for a first time user. The information in product brochures is a bit scant

We have been extremely happy with CSA Services.  We were very impressed with CSA from the time we booked a quote to completion.  We were very happy with Roy who did our quote, the Staff who installed our system and the Office Staff who were always helpful.  Would highly recommend CSA Services.

Wanted to go with a local company. CSA was first on site for an inspection which was impressive as they demonstrated interest and gave me, the consumer, confidence that they were not going to run into problems later. Most other companies gave estimates etc remotely and were just salesmen. Prices were all comparable but CSA was most helpful with questions and getting back to me with answers. Gave me confidence. Loving my new 6.5KW system now.

Good sales person got up and physically checked the roof / all paperwork done immediately and request sent for grid connection same day as completion - very thorough / nothing left to do myself / professional installers (answered all questions I had - fast - did a good job / Best price for the best system (went for Top inverter (Fronius) and mid range panels (Canadian Solar 275Kw) - over paneled 6.6Kw panels for 5Kw inverter for max output.

The guys from CSA were excellent. Very professional and experienced. They explained to me what they were doing at every step. Cleared up after them and did an excellent job. Would recommend them to anyone looking for a solar installation.

We had a bad experience with weather and getting fine days to install the system.    Eventually got it installed with a couple of problems but they were sorted by CSA Services and was very happy with the installation.

The whole process with CSA was handled with professionalism. The sales staff were non-pushy and tried to explain things/options fully. A couple of site visits to confirm/resolve potential issues were carried out. Office follow up quick and painless. The installers were in and out in no time, left no mess and a professional looking job.We've had the system for over 6 months now, with no problems, and 2 bills that have been significantly decreased. Exactly what we wanted.

Still waiting for meter changeover so not yet able to assess operation fully. I previously sent you an email outlining the relative performance of the three companies in the tendering phase. My bottom line is that CSA are clearly the best of the three.
The after sales service and continued contact in regards to power prices and usage is appreciated. We have recommended this company to our friends and family.
We obtained 3 quotes. CSA provided the best advice and then installed on the date promised. A very professional service.
Great product knowledge of system that was installed. the installed system generated greater power than calculated, saving us more money with the electricity suplier
The whole process was explained clearly and succinctly by Roy, who answered our many questions appropriately.The installation went smoothly with the minimum of fuss and the cleanup was spotless.
They didn't stuff us around, they gave us a good price for a setup we were happy with and organised and completed the installation within a few weeks and the system is running really well
Good design, knowledgeable sales and high quality work. Let down just a little by poor communication after the job with sorting a niggly issue.

CSA also kept to schedule for the installation, and acted promptly to correct a glitch, when one panel was not properly connected. They had completed the installation within a day, in very upleasant heat. The team explained what I needed to know, and helped me download and activate the software. Very impressive.
Is it getting monitored by csa
All of our dealings with CSA were very professional. We purchased a 6.6 kW system with quality panels and inverter. The installation process was very smooth and professional.

Everybody we dealt with at CSA Services from sales to installers were great. The installers in particular went above and beyond to ensure the finished job was to the highest standard possible. We are particularly impressed with the manner in which they insisted on taking the more difficult route with the Inverter connection, through the wall cavity of a 2 story home. I was expecting to see conduit running up the wall but they said they would not want it looking like that at their own home. This is the sort of service that has me recommending them to friends and family.

The first installation was wrong, despite me questioning the installer about why he put the panels on the south side instead of facing north.  Apparently they read the map upside down!  They had no problems with agreeing to re-install the panels but on the day of re-installation, they didn't turn up.  When I called an hour later, they told me that the person was delayed and would not be coming that day.  This ended up being a wasted day for me because I took the day off work.  They rescheduled again and turned up on time.  This time the installer left his ladder behind.  They also left a hole in an internal wall.  And the office staff sent me an email telling me they had informed AGL about my solar meter when my retailer is Alinta.Having said all that, the system itself looks good and Roy (salesperson) was a very polite and helpful person.

After having been told different stories about solar, bad or good, I decided to have a go by installing solar: best decision ever.I can now see how this system is really efficient in term of production, consumption and specially value for money.My last bill was 59 AUD for a period of 2 months with AGL, instead of 350 AUD quarterly.

Sales person was very knowledgeable and made suggestions that other sales people had not raised. Excellent installation team. The company was flexible with their installation arrangements so that the roof restoration could occur. Good customer service from the Admin team but on several occasions there were failures to follow up phone calls and that we had to phone for information regarding installation date changes when wet weather occurred.

Since the beginning CSA Services was honest in regards with price and quality of installation, they recommend to check with another companies type of bracket used to have roof tiles sitting flat and also they allow me to choose the location of the inverter, even when it was away from meter board. They cancelled installation one, because crew was sick but rebooked straight away and installation was done in 1 day with really good quality, I would improve installation inside the ceiling, but it is all right. 100% recommend.
Our meter box was old and needed upgrading. There were electrical issues that had nothing to do with the solar installation but the installer persevered to fix the problems. Very professional.

This company were the only ones to physically get up on the roof to take a look. Their price was very competitive and the sales person was happy to answer all my questions and didnâ€™t try to oversell the payback time ( another company tried to tell me the system would pay for itself in 1.8 years, I worked out it will take more like 4 yrs)

Peter Sallens from CSA spent a lot of time with me talking about the differences in panels ( mono and poly,  suppliers) and inverters,  and made a lot of sense out of a complex issue.When the price of the STC's dropped to $26 he asked me if i was keen to get the system installed or would i wait a bit,  as his opinion was that the price would go back into the $30's - it is at $29 today. There are 102 credits for the system I have chosen,  so there is a saving there of around $300.

Our experiance with CSA starting with the sales person  who explained our options very well  and was a delight to deal with,  to the installation team who did a great job, as well as the way that CSA handled our concern with a scratched panel which was replaced quickly without any fuss or argument.All in all a great experience and we are very happy with the output of the system to date, we will recommend your company when ever possible.

Roy from CSA knows his stuff. He was the only quote who actually got on the roof to check it out and not just rely on Google images. This meant he adjusted his recommendations based on the quality of our roof and location of services such as our TV aerial. He listened, asked loads of questions and then provided a tailored solution that was not over or under spec to meet our needs. He was available and accommodating for follow up queries and questions, and saw the project through to completion.

Very professional. From getting the quote to finished installation took 1 week. Email and phone correspondent though all stages and the install team were quick and friendly. Competitive price and great service. Would highly recommend this company.

I knew nothing about solar systems and, being in my mid 80s I thought that I would never get any benefit from one.  However rising electricity costs and lower system costs made me re-think.  I decided to find out as much as I could about solar systems so that I could make an informed decision.  Your website provided the information I needed on solar, and consequently my wife and I decided that it could be a wise move. The system seems to be working well but we will need to get a couple of electricity bills before we are able to make a firm conclusion about the benefits. Incidentally, our decision to install solar had nothing whatever to do with the unproven "greenhouse"gasses theory.
I may change some of the opinions after the installation depending on how it goes.
In general totally recommend CSA. I told my niebour and they have since installed with them on my recommendation same size system.Very happy.
Friendly all round staff
The team were excellent from the knowledge of the salesperson to the expertise and friendliness of the installation crew.

I got quotes from four suppliers and chose CSA Services on the basis of the comprehensiveness and honesty of their advice, quality of the solar PV system hardware and the price. Peter the sales manager was very patient and informative in answering all of my questions. The installation team were very professional and took time to explain the whole process. I'd thoroughly recommend CSA Services if you are looking for a good quality fit for purpose solar PV system to suit your specific requirements and budget.
A professional installation

We did lots of homework (largely thanks to SolarQuotes). The house is really eco friendly (costs 30% less to run than a much, much smaller flat we were living in previously) so I ended up getting an energy monitor just to see how we were using energy and to see if solar electricity was going to be worth installing. It turned out it was. I'm glad that we did this and that we also looked into energy billing (my advice: don't just look at the feed-in tariff but the discount on the usage charge and the supply charge) because it helped in selecting the solar system and the solar installer. It gave us confidence in the financial numbers and being able to weed out the exaggerated information coming from some of the sales people. In this industry you don't just get a written quote, you get the sales person coming to your house so knowing the facts helps you to make that financial decision and not an emotional one or on the best sales spiel. We ended up selecting a top quality 5kW inverter with approx. 6kW PV array. The PV array is made up of mid range, tier 1 panels. Installation was done by CSA Services. They were fantastic from every account. Working in the industrial electrical field I was able to grill the sales person and the installers on every little detail (to the dismay of my wife). They know their stuff and did a great job (even to the extent of taking off their shoes before going into the house. Not that I cared since I don't clean the floors but the curtsy was noticed). After using the system what I didn't give enough credit to was oversizing the panel array. If we had more roof space on the north side I would consider having a slightly larger PV array. In all we have a fantastic system for a fantastic price. Can't thank-you enough SolarQuotes and CSA Services. Alex.
Would recommend this Company to anyone thinking of installing Solar System, EXCELLENT

I have only given rating of 4 out of 5 because our system installation is yet to be finalised (waiting for metering changes from Energex) so we are not yet able to appreciate the benefits of the system and ascertain it's performance. That being said, my experience with CSA to date has been excellent. The salesman was very helpful and consultative in his approach, taking time to understand our circumstances and tailor a system that would provide us best value for the investment.  We were provided with a program for the installation, the installers turned up on time, were polite and professional in their approach, the standard of work was good and they cleaned up after they had finished. (I am an ex-sparky so I fairly high expectations). The office support was helpful, informative and friendly.Based on my experience to date I would have no hesitation in recommending CSA Services.
From start to finish all we could have hoped for.
CSA were  efficient ,service minded and timely in all facets of their dealings with us. A pleasure to do business with. Thank you.

CSA were the only company that the salesperson actually got up on our roof to confirm the design.Important to us that the company employed their own installation team rather than contractors, and a company we believe will be there in the long term to support our installation and their products.
After plenty of ground work & quotes I went with my gut and glad i did, I would highly recommend to anybody.

When I have had any questions on instalation  or information I couldn't quite remember, I was able to talk to a staff member and get the information I needed straight away. Very friendly and helpful staff.

CSA were the best and most helpful and came out multiple times and answered multiple calls in regards to questions we had but the financial service that they recommend to us, classic funding group were rude and and pushy and processed finance and an enquiry on our credit file after only 2mins on the phone even though we said we weren't sure and would like to see all the paper work first then when i said i did not want to go ahead they abused me.
